d:
Why does your heart race, palms sweat, and adrenaline kick in while playing a video game, even when you're perfectly safe on your couch?
In this episode of Sciencekaari, we explore the neuroscience and psychology behind hyper-realistic video games like GTA 6. Discover how your brain processes virtual threats, how the amygdala and prefrontal cortex influence your reactions, and why the sympathetic nervous system triggers a fight-or-flight response. We also decode the science of immersion, Sense of Agency, and Presence in gaming.
